item.title: Lightning Fatality, Missing Plane, Adelaide Shooting
item.ns0:title: Lightning Fatality, Missing Plane, Adelaide Shooting
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, heartbreak and panic sweep through a local high school community after a sixteen-year-old student is tragically struck and killed by lightning just as the school day begins. Off the coast of North Andros, search and rescue crews are hunting for any sign of a missing small aircraft with four people on board after it vanished from radar during bad weather. We also bring you the latest details on a deadly afternoon shooting in Adelaide that claimed the life of a school employee, alongside the government's official response to intense political scrutiny over housing contracts in Abaco. Plus, we examine the looming threat of nationwide industrial action from teachers even as classrooms remain in session.
-----
